title: Improper Content Security Policy (CSP) configuration in the BigFix MCM WebUI allowed the data: URI scheme as a source…
description: An improper Content Security Policy (CSP) configuration in the BigFix MCM WebUI allowed the data: URI scheme as a source in the img-src directive. This weakens the defense-in-depth security mechanism by potentially allowing unsafe image sources. The vulnerability has a low severity score and does not affect confidentiality, integrity, or availability significantly.
